sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong backward-looking results (record EPS, 20.5% comparable sales growth, $9 billion market share gain) but explicitly states that the company is not providing sales and EPS guidance for Fiscal 2021 due to continued uncertainty. The lack of forward guidance and the cautious language around the outlook ('continued uncertainty') prevent a positive forward-looking score. The strong past performance is not a forward signal, and the absence of guidance means no guidance raise or cut, resulting in a neutral score.

summary.revenue: Total revenue of $28.3 billion grew 21.1% compared with last year in Q4 2020. Full-year revenue of $93.6 billion grew 19.8% compared with 2019.
summary.eps: Q4 2020 GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $2.73 (up 67.7% from $1.63 in Q4 2019). Full-year GAAP EPS from continuing operations of $8.64 (up 36.3% from $6.34 in 2019). Adjusted EPS was $2.67 for Q4 and $9.42 for the full year.
summary.guidance: The company is not providing sales and EPS guidance for Fiscal 2021 and beyond, citing continued uncertainty due to COVID-19.
summary.margin: Q4 2020 gross margin rate was 26.8% compared with 26.3% in 2019. Q4 operating income margin rate was 6.5% compared with 5.1% in 2019. Full-year gross margin rate was 28.4% compared with 28.9% in 2019. Full-year operating income margin rate was 7.0% compared with 6.0% in 2019.
key_risks: Continued uncertainty due to COVID-19 impacting consumer shopping patterns and the outlook for fiscal 2021.
Higher digital fulfillment and supply chain costs partially offset gross margin improvements.
Unfavorable category sales mix and higher supply chain and fulfillment costs from channel mix negatively impacted full-year gross margin rate.
key_opportunities: Gained approximately $9 billion in market share in 2020.
Digital comparable sales grew 118% in Q4 and 145% for the full year.
Same-day services (Order Pick Up, Drive Up and Shipt) grew 212% in Q4, led by more than 500% growth in Drive Up.
More than 95% of Target’s fourth quarter sales were fulfilled by its stores, highlighting the strength of the store network as a fulfillment hub.
The company sees continued opportunity to invest in the business and team to drive market share gains and deliver profitable growth.
